## What the L1 result is — and is not

- `hh-l1-conformance/1` **exists** — the G-L1 `full` input is now a real record, not a withheld leg. Its verdict is `result: fail`, `parity: none`, bound to the exact frozen H (`sha256:c451ed97…`) and the gate-A partition.
- The divergence is **structural**: H's assembled first-turn request differs from O's recorded mini-swe-agent prompt in `messages[0].content` (different system/tool framing — `hh_submit` vs `bash`). The strict endpoint refused at turn 1 on every trajectory; this is a genuine experimental measurement, not a machinery void (L1.0 proves the replay plumbing serves 94/94 calls verbatim).
- `full` is **not recordable** — the pre-registered arm requires a pass for the exact H. `fallback`'s recorded arm ("L1 did not pass on either gate partition") is now satisfied on evidence rather than on withholding.
- The earlier interim l1_2 `pass` reading was **vacuous** (0 requests) and is superseded; the final fold's l1_2 `fail` is the recorded outcome.

## Closeout findings

- **Secret-in-argv → journald (machinery defect, recorded):** `ws1-proxy-session.py` carried `OLLAMA_API_KEY` on the command line under sudo; the system journal captured it (8 hits). Committed `journald.log` is canonical-redactor redacted; unredacted bytes ride only in the receipt-bound retained tar. Any future window must deliver via env file/fd, not argv.
- **SCP close-hang (transient):** `gcloud compute scp` hung 38 min on IAP reconnect after a byte-exact transfer; killing the tunnel + re-running teardown resolved it without weakening the harvest-before-delete gate.

## Addendum 2026-11-18T13:15Z — post-window diagnosis-and-iterate (GATE-G29 Reading 2): the L1.1 turn-1 divergence is resolved in-tree; offline re-proof reaches **94/94 turns byte-identical** to O's recorded corpus

Under the operator's Reading-2 disposition ("my disposition is to diagnose and fix any failures and to iterate until success"), the turn-1 `replay_diverged` was traced to its full defect set and repaired. This is an **offline obs-replay re-proof against the committed O corpus** — it measures request-rendering parity, never live-provider operation.

**Root causes repaired (all machinery defects, none task-provability):**

- **Control-driver double interpretation** — a G-INTERPRET-rejected batch pushed `Cue::ModelCompleted` *and* `Cue::GuardFired`; `ModelCompleted{ToolUse}` popped first, read the suppression's empty `pending_intents` as a fresh format error (double-charging the streak), and the stale `GuardFired` burned the next call, whose own completion then charged a phantom third (`hh-control/driver.rs`: `ModelCompleted` suppressed for rejected batches — one response, one interpretation).
- **Global `pending_intents` wedge** — a `follow_up` (or any mid-turn cue) popping ahead of a `model_completed` let one completion drain a sibling call's intents; `hh-control/react.rs` now partitions pending intents by the `action.tool.proposed` scope join (`intent_owners`), marks `dispatched_calls`, and reads a repeat completion as a stale cue (`propose`, never a format-error charge). Unowned entries keep the pre-partition rule (ownerless proposed rows belong to the completing call — regression-covered).
- **First-submit `follow_up` duplicate propose** — `hh-embed/work.rs`: a submit on a never-driven session (`last_cue_seq == 0`) queues no input cue; the seeded `run_opened` propose already drives turn 1. `hh-control/replay.rs` mirrors it: a `context.artefact.delivered` preceding the first `control.decision` synthesizes no input cue.
- **INV-5 scope-key order** — `hh-control/invariants.rs` keys the attempt series on `effect_id` (innermost) before `tool_call`/`model_call`; the first-non-null order collided multi-call responses into `attempt_not_increasing`/`duplicate_commit`.
- **`model.call.completed` conditional closer** (`hh-ledger/effect.rs` + classes.rs comment): a completed call whose `calls` induced tool calls holds the `model_call` scope open for the dispatch leg and settlement tail (the §5a.1 chain requires the parent open while children settle); `calls` absent/empty closes as before. Regression `induced_tool_calls_hold_the_model_call_scope_open`.
- **Audit partition named overrides** (`hh-ledger/classes.rs` + `store.rs`): `model.call.{requested,completed,failed}` gains named dossier bounds — `calls[]` carries provider-sized `args_raw` verbatim (largest measured 13,186 B > the flat 512 B open-partition bound, which would have refused honest rows); unnamed members keep 512 B.
- **Delivered-surface specs for `open_session.exec`** (`hh-embed/open.rs` `exec_surface_specs`): the armed surface's compiled `SurfaceSpec` (surface_id + `input_schema`-derived params via `bind_surface`) merges into `delivered_surfaces`, or every call rejected `unknown_surface`/`schema_violation`. Also: holder→**proposer** ref (the `policy_rule` leg was dead by construction), `connection_info.exec_allow[]` → `ExecPolicy::Allow`, `unattended`+`auto_review` lowering to Π-12 (`Monitor` armed with `HandleTable::project` of the durable permission fold + sealed `auto_review_rules`; `auto_review` removed from `UnattendedRequiresInput`'s hang set — Π-12 endorses or denies, never waits on a human).
- **`KernelSink` writer-lease renewal** (`hh-embed/runtime.rs`): an append whose remaining lease is under 30 s headroom renews in place (`lifecycle.lease.renewed` audited; renewal failure falls through to the append's own honest `Fenced`); `drive()` copies the renewed lease back to the session. The 60 s TTL had fenced a drive mid-flight at ~62 s.
- **SealedDefinition reseal idempotence** (`hh-registry/store.rs` `same_body_json`): the R6 idempotence check compares the identity-scoped body — `assembly.resolved` (`resolved_at`, `registry_snapshot_id`), `attestation.verified_at`, and derived `version.version_id`s are volatile seal stamps the definition's own identity already excludes; raw-body compare made every reseal a `conflicting body`. Pinned `version_id`s elsewhere (`Ref`/`RefVersion` flat members) stay compared. Regression `r6_reseal_of_an_equal_definition_registers_idempotently` (plus a genuine-divergence negative control).
- **`Text.content` parse admission** (`hh-hir/leaves.rs`): a wire doc may carry the leaf's raw text beside its hash — hash-bound (`identify_text == content_hash` or `SchemaViolation`); canonical emission unchanged.
- **GLM transcript render** (`hh-embed/gateway_model.rs`, `hh-gateway/openai.rs`): new `assistant_replay` members — `tool_call_index: emit`, `provider_specific_fields: echo` (`{refusal, reasoning?}`), `reasoning: provider_specific_fields` (emits recorded reasoning at both `reasoning_content` and `psf.reasoning`, sourced from `extra["reasoning"]` or folded deltas); `stream_member: omit` in the pack removes `stream:false` (O omits the member).
- **mswea pack/profile** (`hh_l1_drive.rs` `--mswea-pack`): registers `hh.ws1.mswea-mini@1` — O's two-section prompt layout plus a `transcript`-slotted `held` sink section (keeps the tool description's text leaves out of the user message — they were routing into `task` via `role_map`), profile + test-report registered before `open_session`; `instruction.txt` regenerated verbatim from O's recording (trailing newline); `raws.json` rebuilt — O's recorded environment probe observation prepended (the live probe consumes `raws[0]`), tool observations extracted from O's transcript, 2 elided observations reconstructed `head + filler×elided_chars + tail` (only head/tail/length are observable post-render).

**Offline re-proof result** (`~/hh-retained/ws1/l1-verify`, `--mswea-pack` obs-replay, mock serving the 94-response corpus): **94/94 turns byte-identical to O's recorded requests** (canonical compare); the 95th request is the honest corpus-exhaustion terminal. Run `run-1795006969837-000048-1934b708`: 96 `action.effect.{intended,authorized,prepared,committed}`, 95 `observed`, 1 `unknown` (exhaustion), 95 `model.call.requested` (94 completed + 1 failed), 3 `lifecycle.lease.renewed`, terminal `lifecycle.run.finished{infrastructure_failure}`. Zero rejections, format errors, or INV violations across the full corpus; every `act` dispatched exactly its own call's intents (serial `proposed→completed→act` ×94).

**Verification:** `cargo test` green — hh-assembly acceptance 36/36 (incl. the new reseal regression), hh-embed 344, hh-control suites (incl. `model_completed_dispatches_only_its_own_intents`, `rejected_batch_suppresses_model_completed_cue`, `inv5_attempt_series_key_on_the_innermost_scope`), hh-ledger acceptance (incl. the scope-hold regression), hh-registry; `cargo fmt --all --check` clean; scoped clippy clean on every touched crate — **workspace `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` does not pass**: pre-existing lints in `hh-context`/`hh-compiler` (`type-complexity`, `map-flatten`, `doc-lazy-continuation`) on files this work did not touch; recorded, not weakened.

**Honest boundaries:** this is replay parity, not live-provider proof — `parity` on the frozen H-set stays `none` until the authorized live legs re-run. `SETTLE-Ws1` remains `pending` (clock-honest, last metered call ~06:30Z). L1.2+ live re-proof legs remain operator-gated; none was run.
